IPR 2023 roof interpretation with provisional world origin +0.73m supports main/annex roof18.0, west head21.41 and east head20.50 locally; rigid site fit is pending. No N06 annex room or extra floor is invented; the last N05 mezzanine room has an interpreted taller ceiling.
